name: reporter_cluster_scatter_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Scatter family reporters: xy_scatter (L1-L7), cs_scatter (L1-L5), labeled_scatter (L1-L5), cs_labeled_scatter (L1-L5). 22 layouts total, each in its own category.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Scatter Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
atr_14 = atr(high, low, close, 14)
ts = index()

# Running count
ones = close / close
bar_count = agg(ones, AggregationType.Sum)

# Volatility proxy (rolling std of returns)
ret_sq = daily_ret * daily_ret
rolling_var = sma(ret_sq, 20)

# ========================================================================
# XY SCATTER (xy_scatter) — L1 through L7
# ========================================================================

# L1: Basic scatter — Close vs Volume
xy_scatter(
    title='L1: Close vs Volume',
    category='01_xy_basic',
    y_axis_label='Close',
    x_axis_label='Volume'
)(x=volume, y_values=close)

# L2: Multi-series — Close and SMA20 vs Volume
xy_scatter(
    title='L2: Close & SMA20 vs Volume',
    category='02_xy_multi_series',
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(x=volume, y_values=(close, sma_20))

# L3: Trend line — Daily Return vs Lagged Return
lagged_ret = daily_ret >> 1
xy_scatter(
    title='L3: Return vs Lagged Return (Trend)',
    category='03_xy_trend_line',
    show_trend_line=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Today Return',
    x_axis_label='Yesterday Return'
)(x=lagged_ret, y_values=daily_ret)

# L4: Reference lines — Close vs RSI with thresholds
xy_scatter(
    title='L4: Close vs RSI with Thresholds',
    category='04_xy_ref_lines',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=30, title='Oversold', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=70, title='Overbought', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='RSI'
)(x=rsi_14, y_values=close)

# L5: Axis formatting — PercentFormat on both axes
xy_scatter(
    title='L5: Return vs Volatility (Pct Format)',
    category='05_xy_percent_format',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Daily Return',
    x_axis_label='Rolling Variance'
)(x=rolling_var, y_values=daily_ret)

# L6: Plot bands — Return vs RSI with zone shading
xy_scatter(
    title='L6: Return vs RSI (Plot Bands)',
    category='06_xy_plot_bands',
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-0.02, to=0.02, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Normal Range')
    ]),
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold'),
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought')
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='RSI',
    y_axis_label='Daily Return'
)(x=rsi_14, y_values=daily_ret)

# L7: Markers and colors — Buy/Sell signals scatter
up_close = close * (1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0)
down_close = close * (1.0 if daily_ret <= 0 else 0.0 / 0.0)
xy_scatter(
    title='L7: Up vs Down Days (Markers)',
    category='07_xy_markers_colors',
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Up Day', color=Color.Green, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Down Day', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleDownMarker)
    ])
)(x=volume, y_values=(up_close, down_close))

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL SCATTER (cs_scatter) — L1 through L5
# ========================================================================

# L1: XY mode — Volatility vs Return (one point per asset)
cs_scatter(
    title='L1: Risk vs Return (XY Mode)',
    category='08_cs_xy_mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Avg Daily Return',
    x_axis_label='Avg Rolling Variance'
)(x=rolling_var, y=daily_ret)

# L2: Simple mode — Each asset as time-series scatter
cs_scatter(
    title='L2: Close Prices (Simple Mode)',
    category='09_cs_simple_mode'
)(x=close)

# L3: Per-asset colors
cs_scatter(
    title='L3: Risk vs Return (Colored)',
    category='10_cs_colors',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Green, Color.Orange],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_axis_label='Variance'
)(x=rolling_var, y=daily_ret)

# L4: Reference lines
cs_scatter(
    title='L4: RSI vs Return (Ref Lines)',
    category='11_cs_ref_lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero Return', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=50, title='RSI Midpoint', vertical=True, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_label='Avg RSI'
)(x=rsi_14, y=daily_ret)

# L5: Plot bands
cs_scatter(
    title='L5: RSI vs Return (Plot Bands)',
    category='12_cs_plot_bands',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-0.01, to=0.01, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Low Return Zone')
    ]),
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold')
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_axis_label='RSI'
)(x=rsi_14, y=daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# LABELED SCATTER (labeled_scatter) — L1 through L5
# ========================================================================

# Prepare values for labeled scatter (per-asset, explicit x,y pairs)
last_20_ret = sma(daily_ret, 20)
last_50_ret = sma(daily_ret, 50)
last_20_vol = sma(ret_sq, 20)
last_50_vol = sma(ret_sq, 50)

# L1: Basic labeled scatter — Two named points
labeled_scatter(
    title='L1: 20d vs 50d Lookback',
    category='13_labeled_basic',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Avg Variance',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xy_pairs=(last_20_vol, last_20_ret, last_50_vol, last_50_ret))

# L2: With trend line
labeled_scatter(
    title='L2: 20d vs 50d (Trend)',
    category='14_labeled_trend',
    show_trend_line=True,
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Variance',
    y_axis_label='Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xy_pairs=(last_20_vol, last_20_ret, last_50_vol, last_50_ret))

# L3: Reference lines (x and y separate)
labeled_scatter(
    title='L3: Labeled with Ref Lines',
    category='15_labeled_ref_lines',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0001, title='Low Var', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xy_pairs=(last_20_vol, last_20_ret, last_50_vol, last_50_ret))

# L4: Per-point markers
labeled_scatter(
    title='L4: Different Markers per Point',
    category='16_labeled_markers',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Green, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker)
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xy_pairs=(last_20_vol, last_20_ret, last_50_vol, last_50_ret))

# L5: Plot bands
labeled_scatter(
    title='L5: Labeled Scatter with Zones',
    category='17_labeled_plot_bands',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-0.001, to=0.001, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Neutral')
    ]),
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=0.0001, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.1, label='Low Vol')
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xy_pairs=(last_20_vol, last_20_ret, last_50_vol, last_50_ret))

# ========================================================================
# CS LABELED SCATTER (cs_labeled_scatter) — L1 through L5
# ========================================================================

# L1: Basic auto-labeled scatter
cs_labeled_scatter(
    title='L1: Risk vs Return (Auto-Labeled)',
    category='18_cs_labeled_basic',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_label='Avg Variance'
)(x=rolling_var, y=daily_ret)

# L2: No data labels
cs_labeled_scatter(
    title='L2: Risk vs Return (No Labels)',
    category='19_cs_labeled_no_labels',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=False,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(x=rolling_var, y=daily_ret)

# L3: Colors + trend line
cs_labeled_scatter(
    title='L3: RSI vs Return (Colors + Trend)',
    category='20_cs_labeled_colors_trend',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    show_trend_line=True,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Green, Color.Orange],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_axis_label='RSI'
)(x=rsi_14, y=daily_ret)

# L4: Reference lines (x and y separate)
cs_labeled_scatter(
    title='L4: RSI vs Return (Ref Lines)',
    category='21_cs_labeled_ref_lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50, title='RSI Mid', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_axis_label='RSI'
)(x=rsi_14, y=daily_ret)

# L5: Plot bands
cs_labeled_scatter(
    title='L5: RSI vs Return (Plot Bands)',
    category='22_cs_labeled_plot_bands',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-0.001, to=0.001, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Flat')
    ]),
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold'),
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought')
    ]),
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_axis_label='RSI'
)(x=rsi_14, y=daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# CS_SCATTER — AGG DIVERSITY (17 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_scatter(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    category='AD cs_scatter agg=Sum'
)(x=rolling_var, y=daily_ret)
